snippet.title: 10 Blaze Escape // Teaser
snippet.description:
Steam ► https://store.steampowered.com/app/3118850/10_Blaze_Escape/

"10 Blaze Escape" is an escape horror game where you aim to escape by lighting 10 flames.
*If you have a weak heart, we do not recommend playing this game. It is too scary, so we recommend that only those with a strong heart play this game.

Developed by 
Sudan Minami
